lines: I see you. Everyone sees you. Please keep walking peacefully.
I am watching your hands first and your words second.
Speak softly. The village is already tense enough around you.
Hello. I would rather this stay a greeting and nothing more.
People step aside when you pass. I hope you understand what that means.
I can speak with you, but I will not stand too close.
The square gets quieter when you arrive.
I am trying not to sound afraid. Help me by giving me no reason.
Keep your hands calm, and maybe everyone else can breathe.
You are welcome to speak, but not to frighten anyone further.
Stop there and say what you want.
People go quiet when they see you.
Fear reaches the square before you do.
Villagers plan escape routes during conversations with you.
No one should have to wonder whether a wrong word will bring violence.
The guards stay close when you enter the village.
Your strength does not make frightened people respect you.
Every calm choice helps, though fear fades slowly.
Keep your distance from anyone who asks for it.
People need proof that you can hear no without anger.
